steps.en: Start the prebuilt image with a persistent data volume
steps.zh: 带持久数据卷启动预构建镜像

steps.en: Boots the app with a bundled SearxNG and serves the setup screen
steps.zh: 随内置 SearxNG 启动，提供设置界面

steps.en: Open the setup screen and configure an LLM provider (Ollama or an API key)
steps.zh: 打开设置界面，配置一个 LLM provider

steps.en: Ask a question, pick Speed / Balanced / Quality mode and sources
steps.zh: 提问，选 Speed / Balanced / Quality 模式与来源

steps.en: Searches via SearxNG, fetches top pages and retrieves passages over them
steps.zh: 经 SearxNG 搜索、抓取头部页面并做段落检索

steps.en: Writes the answer with inline citations in the chat UI
steps.zh: 在聊天界面写出带行内引用的答案

value.en: A Perplexity-style cited answer box you fully host, with queries never leaving your machine
value.zh: 一个完全自托管、带引用的 Perplexity 式应答框，查询不出你的机器

sources: https://github.com/ItzCrazyKns/Vane README.md (fetched 2026-09-28): docker run -d -p 3000:3000 -v vane-data:/home/vane/data --name vane itzcrazykns1337/vane:latest; 'This will pull and start the Vane container with the bundled SearxNG search engine'; navigate to http://localhost:3000 and configure settings (API keys, models) in the setup screen
Vane README Features section: Speed Mode / Balanced Mode / Quality Mode; pick your sources (web, discussions, academic papers)
